belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that centred design development user may influence building products successful systems. The evidence base (2 findings, 2 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of centred design development user, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of centred design development user on building products successful systems replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for centred design development user effects on building products successful systems?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
